WELCOME TO THE FOLLOWING NEW MEMBERS

photos.c: 1924 CAN YOU NAME THE BLANKS? Standing: (Left to Right) Charlie Bain, ------, Wally Bayliss, Ken O'Kell, A.E.Smith, Mick Pyer, ------,H. J. Coxhead,Bert Footer, Syd King, Harry Parker Seated:(Left to Right) ------, ------, F. L. Buckingham,Frank Thomson,Harry 'Spider' Bruce,Jimmy Flatt, Arthur Lamm, ------,------.

This is thought to be the start of the Club '10' of 1926. Of the 11 starters, 9 finished. Winner was the smartly turned-out Bert Footer. (3rd from right) alongside of whom is the bespectacled Wally Bayliss who was to become our President, but probably retired from this race. Runner up to Footer was Micky Pyer (extreme left) who won in 1923 and 1924; with George Still (extreme right) 3rd. A.E. Smith (second from left) was 5th and J.G. Flatt (fourth from left) 6th.

Labels on photo: A.E.SMITH, G.F.EASTON, J.G.FLATT, W.A.RICE, A.D.PYER, H.W.BRUCE, J.D.ANDREWS, W.H.WILLIAMS, K.B.O'KELL, H.E.FOOTER. Caption (page 33): The start of the 1926 Surrey County Championship at Epsom Downs
